entry.title: Qian Xun Ji Reborn — Chapters 8 and 9 rebuilt a third time, on the author’s own sequence
entry.summary: The author asked who ever said she was already ninety-two and Titled at eighteen, and the answer is nobody: it was invented, and it is struck. The sequence is now the author’s own. She stands two years at the wall of eighty-nine with eight rings, and the ring that opens ninety is not there. The immortal-herb pill carries her to the razor edge and keeps pouring, and the surplus waits behind the wall the way canon says it waits. At ninety she absorbs her ninth ring — the northern leviathan’s red hundred-thousand, her own kill — and both floods land together: eighty-nine to ninety-five, six levels counted aloud, the youngest Titled Douluo in any record, on the page and not in an invented past. The bone fuses in nine days with two usable skills. Ch08 v3 2,870 words; Ch09 v3 2,673 words; both gate PASS; serial 25,956. Shelf total now 943,404.

entry.title: Qian Xun Ji Reborn — Chapters 8 and 9 rebuilt on the author’s correction
entry.summary: The author corrected the first shipping of these two chapters, and they were rebuilt from scratch. She was already a Titled Douluo — ninety-two, nine rings, Titled at eighteen, the youngest ever — before anything was absorbed. The pill is an immortal-herb pill cut fresh from the secret basin and it lifts her to ninety-five. The red first ring of her second martial soul lifts her ninety-five to ninety-eight, the way canon prices a hundred-thousand (小舞’s ring lifted Tang San six levels), and the hundred-thousand-year torso bone fuses in nine days with two usable skills instead of sitting sealed. And the romance is natural: she asks him to stay, she kisses him first, and in the morning she says “our daughter.” Ch08 v2 2,783 words; Ch09 v2 2,498 words; both gate PASS; serial 25,694 over nine chapters. Shelf total now 943,142.

entry.title: Qian Xun Ji Reborn — Chapter 9, “The Cold North Sea”
entry.summary: The hunt the author ordered: north, to a whale-class leviathan just past one hundred thousand years and three months out of its first heavenly tribulation, where the lightning scar is the only door two mortals may enter. His domain takes the sea away from it; she climbs inside the burn and her venom is in the wound when the heart stops, so the ring is hers. The channels fail first even through the whale gum, he holds what he cannot repair for three days, and the rank comes with the ring as it always does: ninety, at twenty years old, one red ring in a continent of two or three. 2,755 words, gate PASS. Shelf total now 943,975.

entry.title: Qian Xun Ji Reborn — Chapter 8, “What the Sea Sold Cheap”
entry.summary: The watch comes off her door. Fourteen crates of whale gum, bought for the price of an aphrodisiac because the coast has no idea what it is, rebuilt her body; the last of the nine-grade fungus carried her to the razor edge of eighty-nine. The first core attempt fails because her two souls pull the press in two directions and a meridian tears; the second succeeds, and both spiders stand in the world at the same hour for the first time in her life. The pill buys no rank and the core buys no rank: the rank comes with the ring, and the ring has teeth, and the teeth live in the northern sea. 3,359 words, gate PASS. Shelf total now 941,220.

entry.title: Qian Xun Ji Reborn — Chapter 7, “The Cold Broke”
entry.summary: The birth, on the clock canon fixes: month seven, the cold breaking, spring 2620. The strongest man on the continent stands in a locked room and holds a wet cloth, because there is nothing in him that can help. The gold rings come up unbidden and he cannot put them down, and they are his and not hers. And the mother sits up and looks at the child and her face holds nothing at all, and her hands come off the bedframe. 2,605 words, gate PASS. Shelf total now 937,861.

entry.title: Qian Xun Ji Reborn — Chapter 6, “The Colour of Gold”
entry.summary: Rebuilt a third time. The blood-essence ring is an overlay, not a replacement - canon’s only bearer keeps his nine rings and their skills, and the golden rings appear when he activates the bloodline. So the bird’s shield and the sparrow’s blessing stay his, the shield hardens into the grain of his own flesh, a second thing rises out of his chest and doubles his strength without soul power, and the wall comes down to ninety-seven. And the clock is fixed: canon dates the birth to 2620, so only seven months can have passed, not eleven. 3,396 words, gate PASS. Shelf total now 935,256.

entry.title: Qian Xun Ji Reborn — Chapter 5, “The Two Waters”
entry.summary: The Pope goes east, alone and unnamed, to a basin no man alive knows is there: two waters that never cross, and twelve herbs of the highest grade. He takes six and leaves six standing, makes three kinds of pill, forges his body in the springs — and then takes his own first ring apart. The seam tears instead of opening, a meridian opens in the forging and the domain goes out of him, and the ring comes back GOLD — a blood-essence ring with no year, running on blood and not soul power, the kind only two dragon-blooded beings have ever carried. A white-gold layer rises along his arms and a halo turns off the ring, and the pillar stands over the eastern forest for a hundred li. The wall at ninety-seven held; he is still 96, and the cost stayed. 3,380 words, gate PASS. Shelf total now 931,859.
